status: Proposed disabled CPU adapter; not implemented or enabled, no task qualification.
ingress: Use native AddScan for the first adapter; do not silently substitute the explicit RayTrace/max-nohit branch.
input: Only own estimated body pose and own uniform-angle sensor scan; native laser extrinsic applied once. No truth, physical pose or scan-matching credit.
identity: Fresh map per robot/epoch; strict source scan sequence plus exact canonical payload; latest exact duplicate no-op, changed or older ID rejects before SDK mutation.
sensor: Validate configured uniform angles, count, finite range limits and payload before AddScan; unsupported nonuniform scans reject without resampling. Preserve SDK min/max and threshold semantics.
coordinates: Prospectively test SDK center-offset = public ROS boundary-origin + resolution/2; export the declared boundary-origin. This is an explicit phase adapter, different from existing native toNavMap offset export, not a quality-driven half-cell shift. Test signed boundary ties before accepting.
counting: Retain native per-beam pass/hit and defaults; no V2/V3 score, saturation or scan-hit-wins patch. Bind a finite maxscans*beams budget safely below uint32 overflow.
out_of_map: Native false may mean partial in-map update. For otherwise valid input mark scan consumed once and record partial/out-of-map status; never retry it as unconsumed. Malformed input must be rejected beforehand. Integration and safety use require separate validation.
output: Detached original pass/hit counters and explicit -1/100/0 map, row padding removed with GetValue; source ID/clock/version trace. No actor integration yet.
next_checks: Finite sensor-to-counter-to-grid CPU cases: duplicate and epoch isolation; min/max/threshold; offset/yaw and center/origin phase; invalid count and partial update; bounded counters and actual loaded ELF. Only then decide whether any bounded integrated behavior is justified.
